title: One eventual equality between covering restrictions
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $j$ let $P_j$ be a precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Every covering presieve has finitely many arrows. Each transition $F(a)$ maps covers to covers, preserves the pullback of a covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same isomorphism-cover, finite closure and covering-pullback properties. Its covering presieves are exactly transported images of stage covering presieves. Each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $A_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and $H=V_i^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image]. Suppose $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^*H$ and $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^*A_s$ for every $b:t\to s$ in $\mathrm{Under}(i)$ are sheaf morphisms. Composing the adjunction unit for $F(t.hom)$ with $\alpha_t$ agrees componentwise as an arrow with the adjunction unit for $V_i$. Composing it with $\theta_b$ agrees componentwise as an arrow with the unit for $F(s.hom)$. Let $W\in F(t.right)$, let $T$ be a covering presieve of $W$, and let $y_g\in A_t(\operatorname{dom}g)$ for each $g\in T$. Assume that $g\mapsto\alpha_t(y_g)$ is a compatible family in $V_t^*H$. Fix an object $Z$ at stage $t.right$, two arrows $g_1,g_2$ in $T$, and arrows $q_k:Z\to\operatorname{dom}(g_k)$ with $q_1g_1=q_2g_2$. Then there exist $s\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ and $b:t\to s$ for which $\theta_b(A_t(q_1)(y_{g_1}))=\theta_b(A_t(q_2)(y_{g_2}))$. Only this one equation at this prescribed source-stage object is asserted; no common transition or later-stage matching family is asserted.

proof.text: Naturality of alpha at gs and gr and compatibility hy identify the alpha images of the two restrictions x and z. Compare the composite adjunction with the direct adjunction by leftAdjointUniq; the unit equation hAlpha identifies alpha with the V_t unit followed by an isomorphism, so the V_t unit kills x minus z. This is proved by comparison_kernel_iff in the module. Repair: the transition existence helper is imported with import all from ColimitSiteAbelianStageImageRefinement, rather than duplicated. The local kernel-comparison helper is generalized in place to coefficients in AddCommGrpCat at universe max u v, assuming weak sheafification at S and R; the theorem uses its v = u specialization. The existing same-universe helper in SectionEventualEquality cannot be imported without a cycle.
Apply the raw section-formula kernel bound to the sheaf A_t, source stage t.right and arbitrary stage object Z. It places x minus z in the supremum of the later adjunction-unit kernels.

Adjunction transposition constructs the comparison from one inverse image to a further composite inverse image, with its unit equation. Applying the equation to a section proves containment of the first source-unit kernel in the composite source-unit kernel. For two Under(t.right) objects filteredness gives a common successor, so the kernels are directed. AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_directed extracts an object a whose unit kills x minus z. Form tprime = Under.mk(t.hom composed with a.hom) and b = Under.homMk(a.hom). The same comparison_kernel_iff for theta identifies its kernel with the a-unit kernel. Additivity then gives the required equality.
